title: Temporary and virtual tables
goal: Materialize two own requests, reconcile75 and end the temporary-table context.
prerequisites: onec.p6; P1–P3; explicit contracts, types, collections and failure handling.
sections: A temporary table stores intermediate results within an execution context and can support reuse. It is not a persistent catalog. Specify fields, keys and expected multiplicity. Materializing all columns or all source rows can hurt performance; select only required data with justified filtering.
Create a local TempTablesManager. The first query stores only references and minutes of the own customer in СвоиЗаявки. This is not permanent metadata or a global multi-user cache.

Balance, Turnovers andSliceLast expose register semantics. Period and dimension parameters participate in the computation. Filtering afterwards is not always semantically or operationally equivalent to a virtual-table parameter. Establish correctness on a small set before comparing plans and measurements.

Assign the same manager to the second query so it sees the temporary table and returns two facts/75. An equal table name does not transfer context. Separate field/row provenance from the final aggregation.

A shared temporary-table manager can expose an intermediate set to multiple queries. Another query without that context need not see it. A global manager is not an eternal cache of other users’data. Define creation, use and disposal; repeat tests from a known state.

Close the manager after reading. A controlled subsequent access must fail, proving the context ended. Production cleanup must also handle exceptions; this experiment covers the normal path and explicit later failure, not all server failures.

First reconcile temporary rows with source data, then final aggregation with an independent total. For virtual tables, test before the first movement and at a change boundary. Include empty sets. Faster execution with different identities or values is not a valid optimization.

The module6 virtual table computes register semantics over time/dimensions; a temporary table stores a prepared set within a context. Compare purposes. Materialization alone does not prove faster execution.
